summary: Aruba is a sun-soaked Caribbean island paradise known for pristine white-sand beaches, consistent warm weather year-round, and colorful colonial architecture. With watersports, excellent dining, and dramatic desert landscapes, it offers the perfect blend of relaxation and adventure for all travelers.

photography.goldenHourNotes: Aruba's consistent trade winds and clear skies make golden hour particularly stunning. The northern coast faces southwest, offering exceptional sunset light over water, while eastern beaches provide dramatic sunrise opportunities. With minimal light pollution, the island also offers excellent opportunities for night sky and silhouette photography during golden hour transitions.

weather.seasonality: Aruba experiences a dry season from January to April with minimal rainfall and perfect beach conditions, while June through November represents the wet season with afternoon showers and higher humidity. The island's position south of the Caribbean hurricane belt provides exceptional year-round stability and consistently warm temperatures.
weather.summary: Aruba boasts one of the most consistent and pleasant climates in the Caribbean with average temperatures around 28-30°C (82-86°F) and reliable trade winds. The dry season (January-April) offers the absolute best conditions, though the island remains highly visitable throughout the year with minimal rain and virtually no hurricane risk.
